entities.summary: Vladimir Valerevich Yastrebchak was a Moldovan Transnistrian politician who served as minister of Foreign Affairs. He succeeded the longtime minister Valeriy Anatolievich Litskai on 1 July 2008. Yastrebchak's tenure ended in January 2012 when Nina Shtanski was appointed the minister of foreign affairs.
